title: Phone pairing and connection behavior
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on phone pairing, device selection, and connection setup, with most examples describing issues or troubleshooting steps without a clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review says the digital key works well when the phone is functioning properly and not in airplane mode.

negative.summary: One negative review describes repeated pairing problems and advice to reinstall the BMW app and pair the phone again to resolve it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention failed pairing, confusion between multiple paired phones, profile-based connection expectations, and repeated unpairing or setup guidance without enough context to judge sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, so the topic's evaluative direction is unclear from the available evidence.
Several fragments are very short or procedural, which limits confidence about user satisfaction versus simple troubleshooting context.
One example about pairing a garage opener appears unrelated to phone connectivity, so this cluster may mix adjacent pairing topics.
